label: Mettmann into Düsseldorf
why: Kreis Mettmann (0.47M: Ratingen, Velbert, Hilden, Langenfeld, Monheim) is the ring of towns between Düsseldorf and Wuppertal, both in Düsseldorf's metro, which wraps most of it; 60% of its commutes cross its line (20th worst of 4,830). It is one NUTS-3 unit, so it cannot be split between neighbours; it joins Düsseldorf's metro whole. Wuppertal's FUA (1178), whose city the metro already holds, joins Düsseldorf's in source.fua, so pop_vs_fua reads about 1.12 instead of 2.07 (today 1.59 under a relaxation, which can then go).
